title: The Dryad's Bargain
text: A dryad steps out of an oak, bark for skin and moss for hair, her eyes the green of deep water. Behind her the wood is very dark. She offers safe passage through her trees, for a lock of each Scion's hair. She does not say what she does with them.

options.label: Each Scion gives her a lock of hair.

outcomes.text: She weaves it into her branches, humming.
She keeps a little more than hair, and they will not remember what.

options.label: Each Scion keeps their hair, and walks on without her leave.

outcomes.text: The wood is less kind. Roots rise to catch the ankle.
